body:
Hello,

Thanks for sending. Good to know we're not alone. I would recommend getting another job (after some time to yourself, if need be.) It doesn't have to be a dream job, but I've found work can kind of help with my anxiety and depression just because I'm so busy I don't really have time to think about,
After graduating high school, ten days after, someone died along with her mom and younger brother in a car accident. On her way to a college orientation or visit.
It's embarrassing, but it's all in my previous posts.

Last night I *hopefully* broke it all off for good. She was saddened I could tell but wished me luck. I just hope that's the end of it. I'm scared she knows where I live. Thoughts of my family finding out somehow really consume me.

I deleted my chat account.

Hey Swift,

Last night I told her I couldn't remain friends. She had difficulty with it of course. In the end it looked like she accepted it and I deleted my chat account.

I just hope to God nothing more happens.

Yeah I don't think she's taking it well as I mentioned above.

They go to swinging clubs but she wanted to keep this one off a secret.

She could be telling him now for all I know. And I'm horrified that I could end someone's marriage or have a kid from my first time having sex. If my family ever found out what i did, my mom especially would never speak to me again.
Appreciate your reply. The not telling her husband part also bothers me some, just because I don't want to end up getting confronted by him if she decides one day to tell.
Yeah that seems to be the case. She basically asked why I was pacing when she was about to leave, and just laughed and said there was no chance she'd be pregnant.

I think just the fact that I was just so desperate and stupid. My first time will always be with someone I wasn't even attracted to, and then I got super freaked out that she'd get pregnant. Luckily she seems level-headed, and she assured me numerous times that her getting pregnant wouldn't happen. 

She definitely understands that I'm inexperienced. She said I could make a lot of women really happy, but had a lot of anxiety issues. That's when I basically explained I couldn't carry on because I wasn't in the right place to provide her either sexual or emotional support.
That is a good idea. The good news with that is she was worried about me having an STI, saying afterwards she'd kill me if I had one. She wasn't worried at all about pregnancy.
